Push + Abs.name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
Push + Abs.note: Bench at a low incline, lower the bar to your upper chest, press straight up without flaring your elbows.

Push + Abs.name: Chest Press Machine
Push + Abs.note: Seat height so handles line up with mid-chest, press forward, control the way back.

Push + Abs.name: Shoulder Press Machine
Push + Abs.note: Back flat against the pad, press up without shrugging, stop just short of locking out.

Push + Abs.name: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raises
Push + Abs.note: One arm at a time, slight elbow bend, lead with the elbow and stop at shoulder height.

Push + Abs.name: Single-Arm Tricep Pushdowns
Push + Abs.note: Elbow pinned to your side, press down until the arm is straight, control the return.

Push + Abs.name: Abdominal Crunch Machine
Push + Abs.note: Curl your ribs toward your hips, exhale at the bottom, don't pull with your arms.

Pull.name: T-Bar Row
Pull.note: Chest supported or hinged with a flat back, pull to your lower ribs, squeeze your shoulder blades.

Pull.name: Assisted Pull-Ups
Pull.note: Pull your chest toward the bar, lead with the elbows, lower under control to a full stretch.

Pull.name: Seated Cable Row
Pull.note: Sit tall, pull the handle to your stomach, pause briefly and don't lean back.

Pull.name: Reverse Chest Fly Machine
Pull.note: Light weight, lead with the elbows, open the arms wide and squeeze the rear delts.

Pull.name: Preacher Curls
Pull.note: Upper arms flat on the pad, curl up, lower slowly to a full stretch.

Pull.name: Reverse Cable Bicep Curls
Pull.note: Palms facing down through the whole curl, elbows pinned to your sides.

Pull.name: Meow Curls
Pull.note: Controlled reps, full range of motion, squeeze at the top of each rep.

Legs.name: Leg Press
Legs.note: Feet shoulder-width, lower until your knees are around 90 degrees, press through your heels without locking out.

Legs.name: Seated Leg Curl
Legs.note: Pad snug on your lower legs, curl down fully, control the return.

Legs.name: Leg Extensions
Legs.note: Extend until your legs are straight, squeeze the quads for a second, lower slowly.

Legs.name: Hip Abduction Machine
Legs.note: Push your legs apart with control, pause at the end and don't swing.

Legs.name: Hip Adduction Machine
Legs.note: Bring your legs together slowly, pause at the squeeze, control the way back.

Legs.name: Standing Calf Raises
Legs.note: Full stretch at the bottom, pause and squeeze at the top of each rep.

Full Body.note: Bench at a low incline, lower the bar to your upper chest, press straight up without flaring your elbows.
